annotations.title: US jobs report in one answer

description: The US jobs picture in one answer: payroll gains with the three-month average, the unemployment rate and U-6, participation and the prime-age employment ratio, wages and hours, JOLTS openings, quits and layoffs with openings per unemployed person, and weekly jobless claims, each beside the reading before and a year before, with payroll gains month by month. A plain summary first. No key.

months.description: Months of payroll gains and the unemployment rate shown, latest last; default 13.

name: labor_market

outputSchema.description: rows are measures in the order of columns, each beside the reading before and a year before; payrolls gives the jobs added each month.
